newsitem.title: USA: Xlconnect names Wallace president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Xlconnect names Wallace president, COO.

text.p: Xlconnect Solutions Inc said it named Timothy Wallace as president and chief operating officer.
The company did not provide further details and was not immediately available to comment.
Wallace, who had been vice president of field operations for Xlconnect, will continue to report to Chief Executive Richard Ellenberger, the company said.
Prior to joining XLConnect six years ago, Wallace was a managing director of business systems consulting for Arthur Andersen & Company, the company said.
